title: Low-energy electronic excitations in three substituted carbazole molecules
difficulty_reasons: Relevant excitation character can change with structure and representation, so state comparisons require justified definitions.
Separating a supported structure–property association from a stronger molecular explanation requires the agent to design discriminating evidence.

data.description: Full neutral Z identities of three carbazole derivatives and their physical solvent/single-molecule scope; no spectral targets or fixed state-analysis matrix.

required_deliverables.description: Structured investigation with actual evidence, units, identities, conclusions and limits.
Readable scientific report with auditable artifact links.
